name: Micro-TimeTravel Local HTTP Debugger
free_limit: MIT-licensed local HTTP reverse proxy for Docker services with request/response capture, live Web UI, replay and configurable mock responses. Free self-run software without published license usage quota or expiry; default in-memory trace buffer stores 1,000 entries.
watch_out: MVP has no authentication and must stay on a trusted local network; captured traces and mock rules are lost on restart. WebSocket frames are not captured and Docker image build has not yet been verified in upstream CI. Requires own Docker/Node infrastructure; no hosted proxy or free compute is included.
